headline: Hot 3.6% PCE and a Fed with two hike dissents meet Brent near $115 over Hormuz risk, with the Nov 6 payrolls the next big test.
rates: The 10-year fell 7 bp to 4.98% on Oct 29 (2-year 4.61%, 30-year 5.32%) despite September PCE running 3.6% y/y.
fed: The Fed held at 3.75%-4% on Oct 28 in a 10-2 vote with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike, and traders priced about an 84% chance of a hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting; Fed speakers return as the blackout ends.
oil: Brent settled near $114.88 and WTI near $102 as hopes for Iran's proposed Hormuz reopening plan offset supply fears and Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Arabia.
geo: The Strait of Hormuz remains disrupted, Trump denied peace talks are underway, and the Nasdaq fell 1.4% on Oct 29 after Alphabet and Amazon capex worries.
